creator: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) driving the owner's live Krita through the krita_mcp bridge
sourceMethod: New 256x192 sRGB RGBA/8 Krita document. Each state group holds a contact shadow, a 'Pillow paint' group (cream body, inherit-alpha clipped soft cool shade, warm light and seam/crease layers; unmade adds a folded-corner layer) and a warm taupe line layer. Shapes are Catmull-Rom/Bezier QPainter paths written to named paint layers; shade and light layers were softened with Krita's Gaussian blur. Saved with Krita's native KRA writer. No pixels were copied from v1.
exportMethod: Krita exportImage of each state group alone at 256x192 (@2x, alpha on); @1x by `sips -z 96 128` from the @2x file, matching the M1.0f method.
inputs: app-momee/assets/references/concepts/*.png (bedroom panels viewed for pillow colour and shading; not copied into the pillow)
ecosystem-assets/projects/momee/source/bedroom/pillow-v1.kra (bounds and anchor only; file not modified)
preservedBounds: Canvas 256x192 @2x / 128x96 @1x, centre anchor (128, 96), same as v1.
generativeModelUsed: No image-generation model. Shapes and colours were authored as code by the assistant.
reviewNotes: Candidate only. Owner should judge cream versus v1 sky-mist body colour, softness, state readability at the 0.85 CSS px/u camera floor, and whether the pillow should grow beyond the v1 bounds (it is ~1.2x the Boy's head width). The optional contact shadow is inside the canvas and may be dropped at integration. Bridge pixel writes are outside Krita's undo history; the layers remain editable.
